verdict.rationale: Lambda's On-Demand Cloud provides self-serve GPU VMs (B200, H100, GH200) that you can launch from the console or programmatically through the Lambda Cloud REST API, with cloud-init support. Instances come preinstalled with Lambda Stack and JupyterLab and are reachable over SSH, so code can run immediately; the pricing page claims deployment "in minutes". Community reports corroborate this: one user launched a GH200 and worked in Jupyter, and another built a tool that launches instances via the API. Missing for 10: independent measurement of launch-to-ready time, and evidence on capacity availability ("first-come access" suggests instances may not always be obtainable).
